parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the two methods `stopTransitionsToIdle` (line 71) and `isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) share a high Jaccard similarity of ~0.78, they are distinct test cases verifying separate behavioural assertions about the audio player after a stop event — one checks the state transition to idle, the other checks the `isPlaying` flag. Collapsing them would obscure test intent and reduce failure-message clarity, which is a well-known reason to tolerate near-duplicate test bodies.
